name: TURN Server (coturn)

install_consent_messages.en: The TURN relay uses host networking because it relays calls over a range of UDP ports (49152-49252) as well as ports 3478 and 5349. It listens on every network interface of this machine so devices outside your network can reach it. Only callers holding a short-lived credential from Crow can relay through it, but a caller who holds one can relay traffic to addresses on your local network and tailnet too.
install_consent_messages.es: El relé TURN usa la red del host porque retransmite llamadas por un rango de puertos UDP (49152-49252) además de los puertos 3478 y 5349. Escucha en todas las interfaces de red de esta máquina para que los dispositivos fuera de tu red puedan alcanzarlo. Solo quien tenga una credencial temporal de Crow puede retransmitir a través de él, pero quien tenga una también puede retransmitir tráfico hacia direcciones de tu red local y de tu tailnet.

description: Self-hosted TURN relay for WebRTC voice chat. Enables NAT traversal for remote companion access when STUN alone is not sufficient.
author: Crow

env_vars.name: TURN_SECRET
env_vars.description: Shared secret for time-limited TURN credentials (HMAC). Generated by Crow at install and shared with the gateway; never shown.

env_vars.name: TURN_EXTERNAL_IP
env_vars.description: Public IP address of this machine (required for NAT traversal). Leave empty for LAN-only use.

notes: Optional for Tailscale-only deployments (STUN is sufficient). Required when users connect from restrictive networks (corporate NAT, mobile carriers). The companion gateway generates time-limited credentials via /api/turn-credentials using the shared secret.
